name.zh: 简明沟通与项目交付组合

description.zh: 用途：需要简明沟通、按需分析和项目语言维护的任务。 不适用：已要求完整固定分析框架的任务。 这是可选择的行为偏好，不代表普遍最优做法。
description.en: Use: tasks needing concise communication, on-demand analysis and maintenance in the project language. Not for: tasks that already require a fixed, complete analysis framework. This is a selectable behavior preference, not a universally best practice.

zh: 需要简明沟通、按需分析和项目语言维护的任务。
en: Tasks needing concise communication, on-demand analysis and maintenance in the project language.
